integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically from the square-zero power expansion and the rank of the linear map B -> A^(r-1) B A^(r-1). Finite exhaustive computations are included only as sanity checks and are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the maximal nilpotency-index stratum is classified for a general multi-block nilpotent real part; the full distribution below the maximum is not determined. Exact counts require a finite base field, and higher-order nilpotent extensions are outside scope.
title: Largest Jordan blocks control maximal nilpotency doubling over finite dual numbers
